title: RESULTS: November 2026 Customs Brokers Licensure Examination
summary: PRESS RELEASE: The Professional Regulation Commission announces that 2,377 out of 3,440 passed the November 2026 Customs Brokers Licensure Examination

blocks.text: PRESS RELEASE: The Professional Regulation Commission announces that 2,377 out of 3,440 passed the November 2026 Customs Brokers Licensure Examination
The following is a press release from the Professional Regulation Commission.

The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announces that 2,377 out of 3,440 passed the Customs Brokers Licensure Examination given by the Board for Customs Brokers in NCR, Butuan, Cebu, Davao, Koronadal and Lucena this November 2026. The result of examination with respect to one (1) examinee was withheld pending final determination ofhis/her liabilities under the rules and regulations governing licensure examinations.
The members of the Board for Customs Brokers who gave the licensure examination are Hon. Samuel C. Bautista, Chairman; Hon. Nenette T. Dagondon and Hon. Albert V. Cruz.
The results were released in three (3) working days after the last day of examination.

Starting December 21, 2026 registration for the issuance of Professional Identification Card (ID) and Certificate of Registration will be done on-line. Please visit the official PRC website and follow the instructions for registration. Those who will register are required to bring the following: 1) Screenshot of system-generated Registration Form; 2) valid government-issued ID. Successful examinees should personally register and sign in the Roster of Registered Professionals.
The date and venue for the oathtaking ceremony of the new successful examinees in the said examination WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER.
